svg.text: Amazon EC2 · Ubuntu 24.04 · c7i-flex.large · 2 vCPU / 4 GiB RAM
SSH :22 from your IP → Jenkins via loopback :8080
Single EC2 host · no public Jenkins / Tomcat Manager · no Docker socket mounted into containers
Current learning deployment: HTTP only; no load balancer, managed database, or automatic rollback.
